target: Residents and youth in the Maujpur Chowk area, North East Delhi, called to gather with weapons
narrative: A coordinated campaign of 18 accounts posting identical or near-identical messages urges youth to assemble armed with lathis and sticks at Maujpur Chowk near a temple at 5:00 PM on 26 February 2020, framing it as a defensive mobilisation and a decisive confrontation ('aar paar ki ladai'). A shared map URL is distributed across all posts. A second wave at 15:00 IST intensifies urgency with countdown messaging and calls to form a blockade.

legal_suggestions.why: Posts promote enmity and call for armed group mobilisation framed along communal lines, likely to disturb public tranquility.
legal_suggestions.title: Promoting enmity between groups

legal_suggestions.why: The alarm-style messaging ('Emergency alert', 'URGENT CALL') is designed to cause fear and incite public mischief.
legal_suggestions.title: Statements conducing to public mischief (rumours causing fear or alarm)

legal_suggestions.why: Calls to arrive with lathis/sticks and surround the area constitute criminal intimidation directed at persons in the locality.
legal_suggestions.title: Criminal intimidation (threats)

legal_suggestions.why: Multiple accounts posting identical text and the same URL at the same moment evidences coordinated criminal conspiracy.
legal_suggestions.title: Criminal conspiracy (coordinated action)

offline_event.what: Armed assembly with lathis and sticks; surround and blockade the area
offline_event.where: Maujpur Chowk, near Mandir (temple), North East Delhi, Delhi, India
